source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 0d3b1821a6ab40ede911cbe092c661e2560736d5 patch switches the decision map to comm-esr140, mozilla_esr140_tasks and esr140. It separately changes release projects, signing, beetmover and Balrog aliases, merge targets and release-kind selectors. The project consumer applies target_tasks_method and release_type. The attributes module installs Thunderbird values into Gecko taskgraph modules. Next-update YAML uses esr140-next and watershed 128.11.1; its transform maps the key to regex text and appends the argument. The original regex has no esr suffix. The fixed comparison has advanced to ESR 153 with an esr suffix and different watershed values. Direct public Git backout 6ff9645acec2753c896d04a9491b7233926b6feb restores all 13 paths to their exact pre-landing blobs; its parent matches all landing blobs. This supports the reversal, without establishing its cause or later deployment. Keep the producer and consumer strings aligned within each source stage. No graph, release, packaging or updater test ran.
title: An ESR taskgraph rollover changes project identity and release consumers together
